title: Great Barrier Reef Bleaching Returns After Just 2 Years
hook: The Great Barrier Reef is bleaching before it can recover.
closing: Each reef bleaching wave now arrives before recovery can finish.
question: Can the reef keep up?

segments.say: The reef suffered 3 bleaching events this decade, turning a rare crisis into a recurring one.
The reef bleaching gap shrank to 2 years, barely leaving time to recover.
Reef recovery typically needs 10 years, far longer than the gap between bleaching events.
